Privacy

I use Cloudflare Web Analytics to see how many people visit this site and how quickly its pages load. It doesn’t use analytics cookies or track individual visitors.

The reports include page views, referring sites, device and browser types, countries, and page performance. There’s no Google Analytics or advertising tracking on this site.

This only measures the website. It doesn’t collect your papers, annotations, or activity inside the Mac app. Hosting providers may separately process request information to serve and protect the site. Downloads are hosted on GitHub.

Read how Cloudflare Web Analytics works or contact me on GitHub.
